{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Removes [[Eden Editor: Connecting|connection]] between entities.

|s1= [[remove3DENConnection]] [type, from, to]

|p1= type: [[String]] - connection class from ''Cfg3DEN >> Connections''

|p2= from: [[Array]] of [[Eden Entity|Eden Entities]] - entities which has a connection

|p3= to: [[Eden Entity]] - connection target

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] If the connection was removed

|x1= <sqf>remove3DENConnection ["RandomStart", get3DENSelected "Object", "marker_0"];// Remove random start on marker "marker_0" from all selected objects.</sqf>

|seealso= [[add3DENConnection]] [[get3DENConnections]]
}}
